purpose: Independently confirm the E002e modeled PFL3-to-descending steering result after v1 exposed that the 0-degree crossover is not an appropriate sign-reversal sentry for a bilateral label swap.
side_swap_definition: Swap the complete frozen 12-cell left/right PFL3 groups by deterministic (anatomical column, PB label, body ID) rank, treating absent instantaneous drive as zero.
side_swap_gate_scope: all ten nonzero phases participating in the five mirrored phase pairs at the frozen primary threshold
zero_phase_policy: The 0-degree point is reported as a descriptive downstream baseline/asymmetry diagnostic. It is not a sign-reversal gate because reversing bilateral labels does not reverse the sign of a zero relative-phase stimulus itself.
lane_cut_definition: At the primary threshold, a lane cut must reduce the number of preregistered mirrored phase pairs that retain opposite modeled turn signs relative to intact. No amplitude threshold is fit or selected from E002e results.
selection_rule: Do not alter the primary threshold, phase probes, side groups, model parameters, lane cuts, or confirmation seed based on the v2 outcome. V1 remains recorded as 9/10 and is not relabeled as a pass.
claim_boundary: Passing E002e-v2 would independently support a modeled, body-ID-resolved PFL3-to-descending steering transformation under the frozen relative-phase representation. It would not establish sensory-to-goal encoding, measured firing, closed-loop odor navigation, or intact-over-rewire superiority.
